  • Classes in org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.streaming used by org.openehealth.ipf.boot.fhir
    Class
    Description
    Base64SplittingFilter
    Splits the document content out of a large FHIR upload before the body reaches the FHIR parser.
    StreamedDocumentListener
    Notified about every document that Base64SplittingFilter streamed out of a request body, so that the application can meter the split without the split having to know about any particular metrics library.
    StreamingUploadOptions
    Settings of the streaming upload split, see Base64SplittingFilter.

    StagedContent
    Document content that has been extracted from a FHIR request body while that body was still being read from the wire.

    StreamedDocumentListener
    Notified about every document that Base64SplittingFilter streamed out of a request body, so that the application can meter the split without the split having to know about any particular metrics library.
